_doc: REPO-DESIGN-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-27): the questions a session asked about why the repositories are shaped as they are and what stops loops from making every commit. Each answer names the evidence it came from and a probe; tests/foundation/test_repo_design.py runs every probe, so an answer that stops being true fails CI.

questions.a: Sessions. From 2026-11-20 to 2026-11-27, 47 of 349 merged PRs in ultrastable/ultrastable had a bot author (github-actions, the tick App); the rest came from claude/ and ccr- session branches. The target is the reverse.
questions.evidence: GET /repos/ultrastable/ultrastable/pulls?state=closed, grouped by head branch prefix and author

questions.q: Why does the self-executor not ship?
questions.a: On 2026-11-27 it failed 14 of 15 runs. GitHub Models answers every call with HTTP 200 'OK' (since 2026-11-19), and one 502 from glm-4.7-flash marked all of Workers AI down, so working models on that route were never asked. A model-level failure now downs only that model.
questions.evidence: executor.yml run 45956677746 log; direct Workers AI call to llama-3.3 answered

questions.q: Why do writes to workers, spec and license return 403?
questions.a: They are archived, so GitHub makes them read-only. Their code was moved into this repository. It is not an access problem and needs nobody.

questions.q: Why is seed its own repository if code is written here?
questions.a: seed/ is the kernel every system runs. ultrastable/seed is a published copy made by a workflow so a new system can be created from a template. Nobody edits the copy.

questions.q: What does an agent need to work in a repository it has never seen?
questions.a: The fifteen standard files in seed/autonomy/repo-conformance.json: AGENTS.md, llms.txt, REUSE.toml, a Keep a Changelog CHANGELOG, Conventional Commits in CONTRIBUTING, publiccode.yml, a Backstage catalog and the rest. Every writable org repository reads 15/15 on repoconform.

questions.q: How does a repository stay small enough for loops to maintain?
questions.a: Paths are classed by rate of change in doctrine/repo-shape.json, change size is gated by prsize, and an oversize branch is split into a stack, not deleted.
